description: The housing crisis gripping the Golden State threatens to permanently stymie economic growth and demands bold and innovative solutions. These bills will help: AB 1590 by Assemblywoman Blanca Rubio, a Baldwin Park Democrat, would create a first-time home buyer’s tax credit.
